ns2:course.label: Intermediate Hindi I
ns2:course.description: (HINDI 403) First term of second year of the Hindi language, including drill for more advanced conversational fluency; introduction to a greater variety of styles and levels of discourse and usage; and increasing study of the written language and more formal grammar. All students in this course are required to register for one hour per week in the language laboratory. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HNDI 202 or equivalent.
